name: Kingpin: Life of Crime
//queryPortOffset: Servers answer GameSpy queries 10 ports below the one players join; their reply names that port.
//text: Quake 2 engines mark coloured text with the high bit, which only their own font can show.
//masters: Masters list over GameSpy's TCP protocol on 28900; 27900 is where servers send their heartbeats.

keys.//maxPlayers: kpded2 leaves its reserved slots out of maxplayers, so a server whose public slots are full counts as full.
keys.//mods: The gametype is the mod's own title ("Monkey Mod v2.1").

//modes: In order: bagman sets deathmatch as well as teamplay.

launch.//desktopFiles: Only names seen on real installs; Steam's Kingpin.desktop runs a steam:// URL, which drops the connect arguments.

join.//arguments: Each its own argument: run-game.sh recognises a join by " +connect ".

password.//maxLength: Info_SetValueForKey refuses 64 characters or more, so a longer password would never reach the server.
password.//refusedCharacters: kpded2 rebuilds "set password %s", so a space splits the value; iortcw cuts the command line at every '+' and ends a token at "//" or "/*"; both refuse '"', '\' and ';' in userinfo, and Quake 2 expands '$'.
